subject.title: [Bug]: QA profiles schedule live-only channel scenarios on Crabline

question: Should QA Lab make incompatible explicit driver selections fail during planning, while silently excluding incompatible implicit profile scenarios?
rationale: The report proposes both filtering and validation behavior, but their exact CLI/profile compatibility contract needs owner confirmation before implementation.

options.title: Adopt filter plus explicit validation
options.body: Exclude incompatible implicit scenarios and return a clear pre-execution error for explicitly requested incompatible scenarios.

options.title: Filter implicit scenarios only
options.body: Preserve explicit-selection behavior temporarily and limit the fix to profile-generated lanes.

options.title: Keep current selection semantics
options.body: Treat the affected scenarios as requiring broader Crabline context support instead of planner filtering.

recommendation.title: Adopt filter plus explicit validation
recommendation.body: Exclude incompatible implicit scenarios and return a clear pre-execution error for explicitly requested incompatible scenarios.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned MEMBER reporter supplied the concrete run evidence and proposed the relevant shared planner contract.
